headline: Subshell 0.90: home-screen widgets, and plain answers when Reddit blocks
highlights: Two home-screen widgets. Inbox shows how many items are unread and the newest ones. Posts shows Home or a community you've joined. Add them from your launcher's widget list.
When Reddit blocks a request from third-party apps, subshell now says so instead of showing a generic error. The mod queue no longer blames your moderator role for it.
Settings › Diagnostics › Check Reddit access shows which kinds of reads Reddit answers right now and adds the result to the diagnostic report.
Open prefilled GitHub issue copies the report so you can paste it.
Hide read posts is remembered for each account, and a greyed-out item says why. Reset read markers no longer looks like a refresh button.
A short list no longer hides the top bar and bottom navigation when you drag it, and an empty Unread inbox no longer keeps loading older pages.
